title: Chapter 1402 - 15: Past Self, Present Self, Future Self (Part 2)

Chapter 1402 - 15: Past Self, Present Self, Future Self (Part 2)

Chapter 1402: Chapter 15: Past Self, Present Self, Future Self (Part 2)

Reincarnation Immortal King smiled and said,

"Two hundred and thirteen Red Dust Immortals?"

Lin Yuan nodded.

The Red Dust Immortal auras he sensed were only a part; many more Red Dust Immortals were approaching the illusory world at the end of the Immortal Path from different directions.

If one were to imagine the illusory world at the end of the Immortal Path as a sun,

then the many Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings were attempting to approach from all around.

"As for Immortal Emperors, there are three,"

Reincarnation Immortal King said.

"Three Immortal Emperors,"

Lin Yuan’s expression was grave.

Even before descending to this Origin World, through the perspective of the Myriad Realms Gate, he had already noticed three completely sealed timelines.

Only a Time Lord can thoroughly seal their own timeline, which in this Origin World, equates to an Emperor Level powerhouse.

"Are the three Immortal Emperors also approaching that illusory world?"

Lin Yuan asked.

To date, the only Time Lord he had encountered was the Lord of Heaven Light,

And that was a Time Lord who had completely fallen.

"The three Immortal Emperors are mainly locking onto that illusory world,"

Reincarnation Immortal King said.

"Locking onto the illusory world?"

Lin Yuan appeared thoughtful.

"Without the intervention of the three Immortal Emperors, none of us could even observe the illusory world, let alone approach it. The illusory world was not nurtured by the Great Wilderness Origin World but comes from the depths of the dimensional rift,"

Reincarnation Immortal King paused, then continued, "In the early period of the Ancient Era, an alien object fell from beyond the Great Wilderness Origin World, and since then, the undying matter has permeated the heavens and the earth."

"Later, after the first Immortal Emperor observed the past and future, they finally locked onto the location of that alien object, which is at the end of the Immortal Path."

"After an eternity of evolution, that alien object has transformed into the current illusory world."

"In reality, the illusory world formed by the alien object has completely integrated into the depths of the Great Wilderness Origin World. Without the Immortal Emperors’ actions to lock it, none of us could detect even a trace,"

Reincarnation Immortal King said.

"I see."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly, while also becoming curious about the alien object that fell into the Great Wilderness Origin World.

What level of treasure or rarity could it be, that even three Lords could not conquer but only manage to lock onto?

"Illusory world?"

Lin Yuan gazed into the distance towards the illusory world.

"I bet Brother Tianyuan is quite curious,"

Reincarnation Immortal King smiled slightly, "Brother Tianyuan, come with me. Only by approaching the illusory world can one perceive part of the essence of this world."

Soon afterward,

Reincarnation Immortal King and the three Immortal Kings took Lin Yuan to attempt to approach the illusory world.

As they got closer, the Great Destructive Force grew more intense, vaguely accompanied by other higher-level powers circulating, which even made Lin Yuan somewhat anxious.

However,

As Lin Yuan continually approached the illusory world,

This world at the end of the Immortal Path began to change in Lin Yuan’s field of vision.

It no longer appeared as an illusory world but as a ’miniature version’ of infinite dimensional space.

Observing it was equivalent to observing the entire dimensional space.

"This?"

A flood of inspiration and understanding once again surged in Lin Yuan’s mind.

"Why do I feel that this is more insightful than directly observing the evolution of the Chaotic Origin Taiyin and Taiyang Dao?"

Lin Yuan was incredulous.

Six thousand years ago, when Lin Yuan believed he had achieved the pinnacle in all aspects, he utilized the Supreme Rule Dao to transact for an opportunity - the chance to directly observe the evolution of the Chaotic Origin Taiyin and Taiyang Dao.

Originally, Lin Yuan thought this opportunity would allow him to completely comprehend the Taiji Dao of the Chaotic Origin Source.

But he ultimately underestimated the difficulty of comprehending the Taiji Dao of the Chaotic Origin Source. Observing the operation of the Chaotic Origin Taiyin and Taiyang Dao greatly aided Lin Yuan,

Yet trying to comprehend the Taiji Dao of the Chaotic Origin Source from it was still lacking.

Though the Taiji Dao of the Chaotic Origin Source is rooted in Taiyin and Taiyang, it encompasses innumerable Origin Daos.

To comprehend it, merely observing the Chaotic Origin Taiyin and Taiyang Dao was insufficient.

However now,

Observing the illusory world at the end of the Immortal Path sparked numerous flashes of insight for Lin Yuan.

[Your comprehension is extraordinary; observing the mysterious force’s evolution has greatly enhanced your understanding of the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao...]

...

[Your comprehension is extraordinary; observing the mysterious force’s evolution has greatly enhanced your understanding of the Chaotic Origin Life Great Tao...]

....

[Your comprehension is extraordinary; observing the mysterious force’s evolution has greatly enhanced your understanding of the Chaotic Origin Spacetime Great Dao....]

...

Most of Lin Yuan’s mind was immersed in observing that mysterious world at the end of the Immortal Path.

"No wonder nearly all the Red Dust Immortals entering the Immortal Path never returned to the Great Wilderness Origin World, nor even bothered to pay attention," Lin Yuan thought rapidly.

When clearing through numerous forbidden zones, Lin Yuan discovered some backhands left behind by Red Dust Immortals.

But these backhands had not been activated, clearly showing the owners were not too concerned about happenings in the Great Wilderness Origin World.

At that time, Lin Yuan had found it rather strange.

But now it appeared more natural than ever.

With such terrifying insight speeds from observing the illusory world, not to mention the Red Dust Immortals, even Immortal Kings would not be distracted by mundane affairs from the Great Wilderness Origin World.

As long as the Great Wilderness Origin World was not destroyed, the Red Dust Immortals would not interfere in any way.

Of course, other Red Dust Immortals, Immortal Kings, and even Immortal Emperors do not have Lin Yuan’s level of insight speed,

But even so, it’s vastly superior to their usual cultivation efficiency.

...

"The past? The present? The future?"

An idea stirred in Lin Yuan’s mind, and one after another, virtual avatars were created to flow upstream along the timeline, heading towards the distant past.

This technique originated from Lin Yuan’s ninth Physical Body Divine Ability.

Eighteen thousand years ago, Lin Yuan’s physical form successfully gave birth to the ninth Physical Body Divine Ability,

Named "Past Self."

In essence, it involves concentrating a true self in the past timeline.

In this way, even if the true self in the current timeline is annihilated, as long as the true self in the past timeline still exists, it can quickly coalesce into a true self in the present timeline.

This Physical Body Divine Ability leans towards self-preservation; as long as the past is not extinguished, the present remains undying.

Of course, forming the "Past Self" requires Lin Yuan to expend significant time.

But now, accompanied by the improved understanding of the Chaotic Origin Spacetime Great Dao, Lin Yuan’s speed in sending consciousness to the past to consolidate the Past Self has surged.

The complete formation of "Past Self" naturally draws closer.

"Past Self, Present Self, and is there a Future Self?"

Through observing the imbued Chaotic Origin Spacetime Great Dao within the illusory world, Lin Yuan vaguely sensed that this Physical Body Divine Ability was incomplete, with a crucial part being the "Future Self."

By forming a "Future Self" in the future timeline, one’s self-preservation capabilities would again see a major boost.

Once this method is mastered, there would be no period of weakness within one’s timeline, negating the possibility of being killed by a Time Lord who travels to the past.

Once the "Past Self" is completely formed, Lin Yuan’s past and present strengths would be equivalent, with no discrepancy where his past self is weaker than his present self.

...

"What kind of alien object could evolve into such an illusory world?"

The more he pondered, the more astonished Lin Yuan became.

The illusory world contained Chaotic Origin Daos that were so comprehensive as to be beyond belief, and so profound as to be unfathomable.

"Never mind, I’ll delve into the insights first,"

Lin Yuan didn’t dwell on it much longer. In comparison to various gains in this Origin World, his insights into the Chaotic Origin Daos were of utmost significance.

They could be ’shared’ among the true selves of various levels.

"My internal universe is also advancing," amid his insights, Lin Yuan noticed changes within his internal universe.

As various Chaotic Origin Daos integrated, his internal universe grew increasingly perfect, faintly surpassing the Chaos Void.

Thus, Lin Yuan began to wholeheartedly delve into the illusory world at the end of the Immortal Path.

Additionally, Lin Yuan frequently allocated part of his mind to discourse with other Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings.

The Thirteenth Level life forms all had insights regarding Chaotic Origin Daos, insights that had valuable aspects irrespective of correctness, providing Lin Yuan with various experimental perspectives.

Under the direct guidance of the illusory world at the end of the Immortal Path, and through exchanging insights with each Red Dust Immortal and Immortal King,

Lin Yuan’s strength began to rapidly advance once more.
